1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.CutEdgeKiteGeometry
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.HingeIsometries
3 
4 /-! The two apex angles of an actual cut-edge kite agree. This defines
5 the single edge angle used in the later cumulative-angle argument. -/
6 
7 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.CutEdgeMetricModel
8 
9 open Set EuclideanGeometry
10 
11 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {a : frontier P.body} {T : P.CutLocusTree a}
12   {u v : T.vertices} {edge : T.graph.Adj u v} (M : CutEdgeMetricModel T edge)
13 
14 /-- The angle of either radial triangle at its planar source copy. -/
15 noncomputable def sourceAngle : ℝ := angle M.left M.first M.right
16 
17 theorem sourceAngle_pos : 0 < M.sourceAngle := by
18   apply angle_pos_of_not_collinear
19   simpa only [insert_comm M.left] using M.noncollinear.1
20 
21 theorem sourceAngle_lt_pi : M.sourceAngle < Real.pi := by
22   apply angle_lt_pi_of_not_collinear
23   simpa only [insert_comm M.left] using M.noncollinear.1
24 
25 /-- Both sides of a kite contribute the same source angle. -/
26 theorem second_sourceAngle : angle M.left M.second M.right = M.sourceAngle := by
27   obtain ⟨motion, at_source, at_left, at_right⟩ := exists_plane_motion_triangle
28     M.first M.left M.right M.second M.left M.right
29     (ne₁₂_of_not_collinear M.noncollinear.2)
30     M.left_distances M.right_distances rfl
31   have preserved := motion.toAffineIsometry.angle_map M.left M.first M.right
32   change angle (motion M.left) (motion M.first) (motion M.right) = M.sourceAngle at preserved
33   rwa [at_left, at_source, at_right] at preserved
34 
35 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.CutEdgeMetricModel
